hpa.title: Scaling decision
hpa.noMetrics: No metrics are set: the HPA uses the default of 80% CPU utilization.

limited.upPolicy: a scale-up policy limits this step
limited.downPolicy: a scale-down policy limits this step

hpa.heldByMissing: a metric has no value, so the controller does not scale down
hpa.estimateNote: An estimate: desired = ceil(current replicas × current value / target), unchanged within the tolerance; the controller counts ready pods for resource metrics and applies the stabilization window.

behavior.window_one: Waits for a stable recommendation over {{count}} second.
behavior.window_other: Waits for a stable recommendation over {{count}} seconds.
behavior.noWindow: Acts on the latest recommendation at once.
behavior.selectMax: The larger change of these policies applies: {{policies}}.
behavior.selectMin: The smaller change of these policies applies: {{policies}}.
behavior.tolerance: No change while the metrics are within ±{{percent}}% of their targets.

requests.noTemplate: The target's pod template is not visible here, so its requests were not checked.
requests.ok: Every container of the pod template requests {{resource}}.
requests.missingContainer: {{resource}} utilization of container {{container}} is a share of its {{resource}} request, and it has none.
requests.missing: {{resource}} utilization is a share of the requests, but these containers have no {{resource}} request: {{containers}}.

cause.missingRequest: Container {{container}} of Pod {{pod}} has no {{resource}} request, so its utilization cannot be computed. Sidecars injected at admission count too.
cause.noMetricsServer: The resource metrics API (metrics.k8s.io) does not answer: metrics-server is missing or not ready.
cause.noCustomMetrics: The custom metrics API (custom.metrics.k8s.io) does not answer: no metrics adapter (such as prometheus-adapter) serves it.
cause.noExternalMetrics: The external metrics API (external.metrics.k8s.io) does not answer: no adapter (such as KEDA) serves it.
cause.noPodMetrics: The pods have no metrics yet: they are not ready or started too recently.
cause.metricNotFound: The metrics API has no such metric: check the metric name and selector.

hpaReason.SucceededGetScale: The controller can read and change the target's scale.
hpaReason.SucceededRescale: The last change of the replica count succeeded.
hpaReason.FailedGetScale: The controller cannot read the target's scale: the target is missing, or its kind has no scale subresource.
hpaReason.FailedUpdateScale: The controller could not change the target's replica count.
hpaReason.BackoffBoth: Scaled recently: waits before the next change.
hpaReason.BackoffDownscale: Scaled recently: waits before scaling down.
hpaReason.BackoffUpscale: Scaled recently: waits before scaling up.
hpaReason.ScaleDownStabilized: Holds a higher replica count: within the scale-down stabilization window, a recent recommendation was higher.
hpaReason.ScaleUpStabilized: Holds a lower replica count: within the scale-up stabilization window, a recent recommendation was lower.
hpaReason.FailedGetResourceMetric: A CPU or memory metric cannot be read.
hpaReason.FailedGetContainerResourceMetric: A container's CPU or memory metric cannot be read.
hpaReason.FailedGetPodsMetric: A Pods metric cannot be read from the custom metrics API.
hpaReason.FailedGetObjectMetric: An Object metric cannot be read from the custom metrics API.
hpaReason.FailedGetExternalMetric: An External metric cannot be read from the external metrics API.
hpaReason.InvalidSelector: The target's pod selector is missing or invalid.
hpaReason.AmbiguousSelector: The target's pods are also selected by another HPA.
hpaReason.InvalidMetricSourceType: A metric has a type this cluster does not know.
hpaReason.FailedComputeMetricsReplicas: No replica count could be computed from the metrics.
hpaReason.ScalingDisabled: The target is scaled to 0, which turns autoscaling off.
hpaReason.DesiredWithinRange: The wanted replica count is within minReplicas and maxReplicas.
hpaReason.TooManyReplicas: The metrics ask for more replicas than maxReplicas allows.
hpaReason.TooFewReplicas: The metrics ask for fewer replicas than minReplicas allows.
hpaReason.ScaleUpLimit: A scale-up policy limits how many replicas are added at once.
hpaReason.ScaleDownLimit: A scale-down policy limits how many replicas are removed at once.

verdict.disabled: Autoscaling is off: the target has 0 replicas. Scale it up to turn the HPA back on.
verdict.noMetrics: Not scaling: the metrics cannot be read.
verdict.backoff_one: Holding at {{count}} replica: the target was scaled moments ago.
verdict.backoff_other: Holding at {{count}} replicas: the target was scaled moments ago.
verdict.cannotScale: Not scaling: the target's replica count cannot be read or changed.
verdict.stabilizedDown_one: Holding at {{count}} replica: the scale-down stabilization window keeps the highest recent recommendation.
verdict.stabilizedDown_other: Holding at {{count}} replicas: the scale-down stabilization window keeps the highest recent recommendation.
verdict.stabilizedUp_one: Holding at {{count}} replica: the scale-up stabilization window keeps the lowest recent recommendation.
verdict.stabilizedUp_other: Holding at {{count}} replicas: the scale-up stabilization window keeps the lowest recent recommendation.
verdict.atMax_one: At the maximum of {{count}} replica: the metrics ask for more (by this estimate: {{wanted}}).
verdict.atMax_other: At the maximum of {{count}} replicas: the metrics ask for more (by this estimate: {{wanted}}).
verdict.atMin_one: At the minimum of {{count}} replica: the metrics ask for fewer (by this estimate: {{wanted}}).
verdict.atMin_other: At the minimum of {{count}} replicas: the metrics ask for fewer (by this estimate: {{wanted}}).
verdict.upLimit_one: Scaling up step by step to {{count}} replica: a scale-up policy limits each step.
verdict.upLimit_other: Scaling up step by step to {{count}} replicas: a scale-up policy limits each step.
verdict.downLimit_one: Scaling down step by step to {{count}} replica: a scale-down policy limits each step.
verdict.downLimit_other: Scaling down step by step to {{count}} replicas: a scale-down policy limits each step.
verdict.noStatus: No status yet: the controller has not processed this HPA.
verdict.heldByMissing_one: Holding at {{count}} replica: a metric has no value, and the controller does not scale down without it.
verdict.heldByMissing_other: Holding at {{count}} replicas: a metric has no value, and the controller does not scale down without it.
verdict.steady_one: Steady at {{count}} replica: every metric is within the tolerance of its target.
verdict.steady_other: Steady at {{count}} replicas: every metric is within the tolerance of its target.

workload.conflict_other: {{count}} HorizontalPodAutoscalers target this workload: they fight over its replicas.
workload.manualScale: The autoscaler sets the replicas: a manual scale lasts only until its next sync.

sched.title: Why the Pod is not scheduled
sched.noMessage: The scheduler has not said why yet.

reason.taintNamed: A taint the Pod does not tolerate: {{taint}}
reason.taint: A taint the Pod does not tolerate
reason.nodeAffinity: Does not match the Pod's nodeSelector or node affinity
reason.podAffinity: Does not match the Pod's pod affinity
reason.existingAntiAffinity: Breaks the anti-affinity of Pods already there
reason.volumeAffinity: A PersistentVolume of the Pod is not reachable from it
reason.volumeBinding: No PersistentVolume to bind is available there
reason.unboundPvc: A PersistentVolumeClaim of the Pod is not bound
reason.ports: The Pod's host ports are taken
reason.maxGroupSize: The node group is at its maximum size
reason.backoff: The node group is in backoff after a failed scale-up
reason.clusterLimit: A cluster-wide resource limit of the autoscaler is reached

check.title: Check against the nodes
check.failed: The nodes or the Pods could not be read, so the check did not run.
check.loading: Reading the nodes and the Pods on them…
check.none: By this check, no node fits.
check.fits_one: By this check the Pod fits on {{count}} node (of {{total}} checked).
check.fits_other: By this check the Pod fits on {{count}} nodes (of {{total}} checked).
check.fitsButPending: The scheduler may have tried before these nodes had room, or a reason this check does not judge applies.
check.bounded_one: Only the first {{count}} node by name was checked (of {{total}}).
check.bounded_other: Only the first {{count}} nodes by name were checked (of {{total}}).
check.truncated: The cluster has more nodes or Pods than are kept here; the free amounts may be off.
check.otherTotal: Nodes the scheduler counted: {{scheduler}}; nodes seen here: {{total}}.
check.uncheckedNamespaces: Pod affinity terms of other namespaces or with a namespaceSelector are not checked.
check.uncheckedPeers: Pod affinity and topology spread are not checked: the Pods of the namespace are not known yet.
check.notChecked: Not checked here: the anti-affinity of other Pods against this one, host ports, volume limits and dynamic resources.

node.nodeSelector: Its labels do not match the Pod's nodeSelector
node.nodeAffinity: Does not match the Pod's required node affinity
node.insufficient: Not enough {{resource}}: the Pod requests {{requested}}, {{free}} of {{allocatable}} is free
node.missingTopologyLabel: No {{key}} label, which a constraint of the Pod needs
node.podAffinity: No Pod matching the required pod affinity runs in its {{key}} domain
node.podAntiAffinity: A Pod matching the required pod anti-affinity runs in its {{key}} domain
node.volumeAffinity: PersistentVolume {{pv}} is not reachable from this node

karpenter.title: Karpenter
karpenter.noDecision: Karpenter has not reported a decision for this Pod yet.
karpenter.poolLimit: NodePool {{name}} is at its limit for {{resources}}: it launches no more nodes.
karpenter.notRegistered: Launched, but the node has not joined the cluster: {{reason}}.
karpenter.notInitialized: The node joined but is not initialized yet: {{reason}}.
karpenter.disrupting: Karpenter is disrupting this node: it is tainted and its Pods are being moved.
karpenter.drifted: Drifted ({{reason}}): the node no longer matches its NodePool or node class, so Karpenter replaces it.
karpenter.consolidatable: Can be consolidated (policy: {{policy}}): Karpenter may remove or replace it with a cheaper node.
karpenter.empty: Empty: no workload Pods run here, so Karpenter may remove it.
karpenter.expired: Expired: the node reached its expireAfter, so Karpenter replaces it.
karpenter.doNotDisrupt: The annotation {{annotation}} keeps Karpenter from disrupting it voluntarily.
karpenter.noLimits: No limits: the NodePool may launch nodes without bound.

ca.title: Cluster Autoscaler
ca.triggered: Cluster Autoscaler is adding nodes for this Pod: {{groups}}.
ca.notTriggered: Cluster Autoscaler would not add a node for this Pod:
ca.toBeDeleted: Cluster Autoscaler is removing this node: it is tainted and its Pods are being evicted.
ca.candidate: Cluster Autoscaler marked this node as a candidate for removal (underused).
ca.scaleDownDisabled: The annotation {{annotation}} keeps Cluster Autoscaler from removing it.

keda.title: KEDA
keda.notReady: KEDA cannot scale this object ({{reason}}): see the Ready condition and the events.
keda.paused: Paused by the annotation {{annotation}}: KEDA does not scale the target.
keda.pausedAt: Paused by the annotation {{annotation}}: the target is held at this replica count: {{replicas}}.
keda.fallback: Fallback is in use: a trigger keeps failing, so the target runs the fallback replica count: {{replicas}}.
keda.triggerFailing_one: Trigger {{trigger}} failed {{count}} time in a row.
keda.triggerFailing_other: Trigger {{trigger}} failed {{count}} times in a row.
keda.jobActive: Active: a trigger is above its activation threshold, so KEDA creates Jobs (maxReplicaCount: {{max}}).
keda.jobInactive: Inactive: no trigger is above its activation threshold, so no Jobs are created.
keda.active: Active: a trigger is above its activation threshold, so the HPA scales the target (replicas: {{min}}–{{max}}).
keda.inactiveIdle: Inactive: no trigger is above its activation threshold, so the target is kept at its idle replica count: {{replicas}}.
keda.inactive: Inactive: no trigger is above its activation threshold, so the HPA keeps the target at minReplicaCount: {{replicas}}.
keda.hpaMissing: The HPA {{name}} that KEDA manages for this ScaledObject is not there.
keda.name: Name
